cookbook.col_fit_hint: Hardware compatibility estimate — hover cell for explanation

mission.title: Autonomous mission
mission.description: Like a small organization: you set a goal and operating rules; the daemon periodically kicks the orchestrator (heartbeat) to make progress without prompting you. Markdown reports go under the configured directory. The daemon must keep running.
mission.intro_detail: The first step of each heartbeat uses the selected agent type (often project manager); the orchestrator may then delegate according to the roles you describe.
mission.operating_rules_hint: Constraints, tone, expected deliverables, preferred tools — injected into heartbeats and recalled in mission mode for the linked session.
mission.roles_hint: Describe roles like a team; the orchestrator may delegate to the agent types you set.
mission.heartbeat_task_type_hint: First step of each cycle; further delegations are still decided by the orchestrator.
mission.unavailable: Autonomous mission API is unavailable (daemon not ready or config failed to load).
scheduled.description: Agent responses for scheduled tasks (recurring reminders).
scheduled.empty: No scheduled task returns yet. Recurring schedule responses appear here.
update.banner_install: Download and install it, then follow the steps below to validate your config.
update.steps_title: Steps to validate config after update
update.step1: Download and install the new version.
update.step2: Restart the daemon if needed: akasha start
update.step3: Check config (akasha doctor) and Settings tab.
pending_actions.title: Requests awaiting your response
chat.thread_delete_confirm: Delete this conversation and its history on this device?
chat.threads_empty: No conversations yet. Create one to get started.
chat.hero_title: A local assistant with a clearer, friendlier interface
chat.hero_simple: Simple mode keeps the focus on the conversation, overall status, and useful next actions instead of flooding the screen with technical detail.
chat.hero_expert: Expert mode exposes more operational detail, steps, and events so you can inspect what the agents are doing in depth.
chat.no_events_yet: No steps received yet. Events (delegation, sub-agents, progress) will appear here.
chat.agent_activity_expand_hint: Show agent activity — steps will appear as they run
chat.prompt_chip_2: Summarize what you did so far.
chat.prompt_chip_3: What should I check or clarify?
chat.buddy_line_1: Ready when you are — ask anything.
chat.buddy_line_2: Tip: use the Tasks tab to see full detail.
chat.buddy_line_3: Short questions often get faster answers.
chat.companion_action_required: Action required: reply to the pending question to unblock the agent.
chat.companion_thinking: I'm preparing a full answer. You can still add one key detail if needed.
chat.companion_draft: Good start. Press Enter to send, or add one important detail.
chat.companion_idle: I'm ready for a short or detailed request.
chat.empty: No requests recorded. Send a message in Chat
docs.title: User documentation
tasks.title: Tasks (Task Center)
tasks.empty: No tasks. Send a message in Chat.
tasks.map_geometry_great_circle_note: The blue trace is a great-circle path between the resolved places (shortest path on the globe), not roads or rail. The OpenStreetMap panel shows the region without a route overlay — use Open in browser or a navigation app for real routing.
tasks.map_geometry_road_network_note: The main trace comes from a routing engine (OpenStreetMap road network). The steps below follow the provider’s itinerary; verify on site or with a GPS app.
tasks.map_osm_hint: Interactive map (OpenStreetMap tiles). No route line is drawn on the map; the blue schematic is separate (see note above).
tasks.map_osm_hint_chat: Map of the region (no route drawn on it). Open in the browser to zoom or navigate.
tasks.map_osm_with_leaflet_hint: The interactive map above shows the route. Use the link to open the same area on openstreetmap.org (new tab).
tasks.map_schematic_details_summary: Schematic trace (simplified line, not a geographic map)
tasks.pan_zoom_hint: Use mouse wheel or pinch to zoom, drag to pan, double-click to fit to screen.
tasks.zoom_shortcuts_hint: Keyboard shortcuts: + to zoom in, - to zoom out, 0 to reset.
tasks.visual_help_mouse: Mouse: wheel to zoom, drag to pan, double-click to fit to screen.
tasks.visual_help_touch: Touch / trackpad: pinch to zoom, drag to pan.
tasks.visual_help_keyboard: Keyboard: + zoom in, - zoom out, 0 reset, ? toggle this help.
tasks.steps_empty: No steps defined for this task.
tasks.steps_empty_direct: Direct task — no orchestrated breakdown for this task.
tasks.create_tip_tab_immediate: Starts an agent task right away, like sending a message in Chat.
tasks.create_tip_tab_recurring: Schedules a task that repeats on an interval or RRULE/cron rule.
tasks.create_tip_tab_oneshot: Runs a task once at the chosen date and time.
tasks.create_tip_tab_trigger: Creates a rule that automatically starts a task when an event occurs.
tasks.create_tip_message: Instruction sent to the agent: goal, context, and expected outcome.
tasks.create_tip_priority: High priority: the task is queued ahead of normal-priority work.
tasks.create_tip_schedule_name: Display name in Calendar and the recurrence list.
tasks.create_tip_schedule_prompt: Message run on each occurrence — the work assigned to the agent.
tasks.create_tip_interval: Seconds between runs (e.g. 3600 = hourly). Ignored when an RRULE is set.
tasks.create_tip_rrule: Advanced iCal rule (optional). E.g. FREQ=DAILY;BYHOUR=9 for every day at 9:00.
tasks.create_tip_oneshot_at: Local date and time of the single planned run.
tasks.create_tip_trigger_name: Label to find this trigger in the Task Center.
tasks.create_tip_trigger_type: Event source: inbound webhook, failed task, filesystem, new LLM model, or daemon error.
tasks.create_tip_trigger_filter: JSON criteria (provider, path, etc.). Use {} to match all events of the selected type.
tasks.create_tip_trigger_prompt: Prompt template; {{payload.field}} placeholders are filled from the event data.
tasks.event_summary_hint: Simplified view: recent events come first, and technical payloads stay collapsed until needed.
tasks.agent_discussions_hint: This view highlights orchestration signals (reasoning, delegations, attempts, phases) to better understand and debug agent interactions.
tasks.agent_discussions_hint_minimal: Minimal level: primary orchestration signals (decomposition, delegation, milestones, contract violations) for fast reading.
tasks.agent_discussions_hint_normal: Normal level: orchestration signals plus relevant progress to understand flow and diagnose interactions.
tasks.agent_discussions_hint_full: Full level: expanded event timeline for orchestration and progress to support deep debugging.
calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.no_schedules: No recurrences. Create via API or a tool.
calendar.channel_context: Request sent to agents each iteration:
calendar.no_channel: No request configured for this recurrence (channel_context and description empty).
memory.title: Memory
memory.long_unavailable: Long-term memory not available (embeddings not configured or disabled).
memory.detail_links_none: No links. Graph lines only appear when relations exist and both nodes are in the loaded list.
memory.detail_link_not_in_list: Not in loaded list (a line may still connect this node if it is referenced).
memory.detail_click_hint: Single click: recenter on node. Double click: open this detail.
memory.advanced_settings_hint: Applies to the running daemon immediately. Persist in akasha.env for restarts.
settings.title: Settings
settings.ui_mode_hint: Simple = calmer, more digestible reading; Expert = more technical detail visible.
settings.utility_model_hint: Utility model (task_types.utility in llm_router.yaml): compaction, thread titles, compare synthesis.
settings.system_health_no_session: (No active session — open or select a chat thread to show session resume.)
settings.plugins_uninstall_confirm: Permanently uninstall plugin "{id}"? This removes its files from disk.
settings.plugin_reputation_desc: Reset reputation for a disabled plugin (e.g. maps), then reload it automatically.
settings.user_rag_desc: Documents added here are indexed and used by agents to answer your questions. Supported formats: text (.txt, .md, .csv, .json).
settings.workspace_graph_desc: Register one or more project folders (Rust AST via tree-sitter, Markdown headings, plain text metadata). Each workspace writes graph.json, GRAPH_REPORT.md, and graph.html under workspace_graph/out/<id>/. No code is sent to an LLM for this pass.
settings.workspace_graph_ok: Indexed: {{files}} files, {{nodes}} nodes, {{edges}} edges. Reports are in your Akasha data folder under workspace_graph/out/.
settings.workspace_graph_cleared: Path cleared (YAML updated). Set a folder and save again to index.
settings.project_graph_empty: No project workspace yet. Add a display name and an absolute folder path above.
settings.project_graph_created_ok: Workspace created. Indexed {{files}} files, {{nodes}} nodes, {{edges}} edges. Each workspace has its own folder under workspace_graph/out/.
settings.project_graph_confirm_delete: Delete project workspace "{{name}}" and remove its database rows and workspace_graph/out files for this id?
settings.no_documents: No documents. Click "Add a document" to add some.
settings.config_note: Configuration: AKASHA_*, OLLAMA_HOST environment variables. See Documentation tab for full guide.
settings.agent_profile_desc: Agent name and personality. The name is used in the prompt; if empty, "Akasha" is used by default.
settings.agent_profile_system_prompt_hin: Additional system instructions prepended to the agent context.
settings.agent_profile_temperature_hint: LLM sampling temperature (0–2). Leave empty for default (0.7).
notes.insert_in_chat: Insert a note as chat context
theme_editor.title: Theme overrides
theme_editor.desc: Override CSS variables for the selected theme. Saved locally in this browser.
theme_editor.var_bg_hint: Main background color. E.g. #0d1117 or rgb(13, 17, 23). Leave empty for theme default.
theme_editor.var_surface_hint: Panel and card background. E.g. #161b22. Leave empty for theme default.
theme_editor.var_accent_hint: Accent color (links, buttons). E.g. #58a6ff or hsl(210 100% 60%).
settings.agent_identity_constitution_hin: Name and role feed both the chat profile (agent_profile.json) and long-term constitution (agent_identity.yaml). Tone, values and constraints are stored for permanent memory.
tools_policy.desc: Machine tools policy (tools_policy.yaml). Changes apply immediately after save.
tools_policy.missing_file: File missing — run « akasha doctor --fix » to create it.
tools_policy.section_paths_help: Define where the agent can read and write files. Use "." for the daemon working directory, or a dedicated absolute project path.
tools_policy.section_commands_help: Controls shell commands (run_command). Allow only required binaries (git, npm, cargo…). blocked_commands overrides allowed_commands.
tools_policy.section_web_help: External search and fetch. web_search queries providers (SearXNG, DuckDuckGo work without API keys). web_fetch loads a URL if its domain is allowed below.
tools_policy.section_web_tip: After search, web_fetch can complement snippets with full page content from allowed domains.
tools_policy.section_browser_help: Playwright automation (navigate, snapshot). Requires Chromium in the Playwright runner. Restrict domains to avoid arbitrary browsing.
tools_policy.section_browser_tip: Useful for JS-heavy pages (weather, dashboards) where web_fetch is insufficient.
tools_policy.section_devices_help: Interfaces for camera, microphone, synthetic input (keyboard/mouse). local_media = webcam/mic ; synthetic_input = simulated shortcuts and clicks.
tools_policy.section_devices_tip: Example: allowed_device_interfaces: [local_media] for webcam photos ; add synthetic_input for games or drawing apps.
tools_policy.section_profiles_help: A tool profile whitelists tools (e.g. dev_sandbox = read_file, write_file, git_*). default_profile applies this filter to all tasks.
tools_policy.section_profiles_tip: If default_profile is empty, all built-in tools pass other rules (paths, commands, etc.). write_code is allowed when write_file is in the profile.
tools_policy.section_approval_help: Human-in-the-loop: the UI asks for confirmation before running these tools (e.g. write_file, run_command, device_invoke).
tools_policy.section_approval_tip: Recommended for install_playwright (large download) and device_invoke (camera, synthetic input).
tools_policy.section_skills_mcp_help: Allowed HTTPS hosts for install_skill (default: GitHub). MCP: external tool servers mcp_<server>_<tool>.
tools_policy.allowed_commands_hint: Command names or paths (cargo, npm, git). Use * to allow all (subject to blocked_commands).
tools_policy.blocked_commands_hint: Commands denied even when allowed_commands contains * (e.g. rm, format).
tools_policy.command_timeout_secs_hint: Max duration in seconds for run_command / run_terminal.
tools_policy.run_command_default_cwd_wor: Without --cwd, run_command uses the task workspace instead of the daemon directory.
tools_policy.web_search_enabled_hint: Enables web_search. Optional API keys in vault (Brave, Tavily…); SearXNG/DuckDuckGo work keyless.
tools_policy.web_crawl_enabled_hint: Enables web_crawl via Cloudflare Browser Rendering (account + token required).
tools_policy.search_provider_hint: auto, searxng, duckduckgo, brave, tavily, serper, google_pse or disabled.
tools_policy.searxng_url_hint: Public or self-hosted SearXNG instance (e.g. https://searx.be).
tools_policy.allowed_web_domains_hint: Domains for web_fetch. * = all (subject to blocked_web_domains).
tools_policy.blocked_web_domains_hint: Domains denied for web_fetch; overrides allowed_web_domains.
tools_policy.browser_enabled_hint: Enables browser navigate, browser snapshot, etc. Install Playwright if needed.
tools_policy.browser_headless_hint: true = invisible window ; false = visible window (debugging).
tools_policy.browser_allowed_domains_hin: Hosts allowed for browser navigate (e.g. localhost, example.com). * = all.
tools_policy.browser_blocked_domains_hin: Hosts denied for the managed browser.
tools_policy.allowed_device_interfaces_h: local_media, synthetic_input, system, usb or * for all.
tools_policy.blocked_device_interfaces_h: Denied interfaces (e.g. usb) even when * is allowed.
tools_policy.default_profile_hint: Active profile name. Only tools listed in tool_profiles[profile] are available.
tools_policy.allowed_skill_install_hosts: HTTPS hosts for install_skill (github.com, gitlab.com…). * = all.
tools_policy.mcp_max_calls_per_task_hint: Global MCP call limit per task (0 = unlimited if unset).
tools_policy.allowed_write_paths_hint: Prefixes where the agent may write files.
tools_policy.run_command_default_cwd_wor: Use task workspace as cwd for run_command when no --cwd
connectors.desc: Enable messaging channels, configure secrets (encrypted in vault) and options. Daemon restart required after changes.
connectors.restart_required: Daemon restart required to apply connector changes.
connectors.secret_keep_placeholder: Leave blank to keep current secret
connectors.telegram_section_help: Telegram bot via @BotFather. Token stored in vault (telegram_bot_token). Commands /akasha and /start.
connectors.telegram_token_hint: Bot API token (format 123456789:ABC…). From @BotFather → /newbot. Never shown after save.
connectors.telegram_notify_chat_id_hint: Optional. Numeric chat ID for « bot connected » on startup (connectors.env).
connectors.slack_section_help: Slack slash command. Requires slack_signing_secret (app Signing Secret) and AKASHA_SLACK_ENABLED=1.
connectors.slack_signing_secret_hint: Slack API → Your App → Basic Information → Signing Secret.
connectors.discord_section_help: Discord bot. Token stored in vault (discord_bot_token). Bot responds on the daemon port.
connectors.discord_token_hint: Discord Developer Portal → Bot → Token. Message Content Intent if needed.
connectors.ha_section_help: Smart home via Home Assistant: URL (akasha discover homeassistant), long-lived token in vault (ha_access_token). Install the homeassistant plugin.
connectors.ha_base_url_hint: E.g. http://127.0.0.1:8123 or http://homeassistant.local:8123. Use Detect to scan the local network.
connectors.ha_discover_empty: No Home Assistant instance detected. Install HA or enter the URL manually.
connectors.ha_token_hint: Long-lived token (HA Profile → Security). Stored in vault.
connectors.matrix_desc: Matrix uses the matrix-channel plugin: MATRIX_HOMESERVER_URL and token in connectors.env, plus the matrix-channel sidecar.
settings.user_profile_desc: This information lets the agent greet you and address you personally (first name, how to call you).
settings.user_profile_how_to_call_hint: First name or nickname the agent will use when speaking to you (e.g. Marc).
settings.user_profile_proactive_enabled_: Offer help after a period without interaction
settings.user_profile_proactive_interval: Number of days without a message before the agent offers help (e.g. 1 = daily, 7 = weekly). 0 = disabled.
settings.agent_traits_desc: Adjust response style (0 = minimal, 1 = maximal). Empty = default Akasha values.
settings.agent_add_line_placeholder: One rule or condition per line…
settings.agent_list_empty: No entries. Type a line on the left and click Add.
settings.agent_profile_formality_hint: Affects how you are addressed in French (vous / tu) and overall register in other languages.
settings.chat_tips_hint: Show a daily tip banner above the conversation (from tips.json).
settings.chat_prompt_chips_hint: Show quick follow-up chips above the message field.
settings.chat_buddy_hint: Show a short optional line under the header (cosmetic).
chat.follow_tasks: You can follow progress in the Tasks tab.
human_input.banner: A question is waiting — click « Reply » to respond from any tab.
device_bridge.title: Device access
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.check_center: See the notification center (bell icon) for details.
onboarding.title: First launch
onboarding.intro: Welcome to Akasha. This wizard helps you reach a first successful chat with the embedded model — no manual YAML required.
onboarding.daemon.off: Start the daemon with `akasha start` before continuing.
onboarding.health.hint: Run doctor --fix to create missing config files (llm_router.yaml, tools_policy, vault).
onboarding.embedded.loadingHint: Model loading on first message may take 1–3 minutes (CPU) or seconds (GPU after download).
onboarding.embedded.ready: Ready (embedded model available). On CPU builds the first call may be slow.
onboarding.firstMessage.hint: Send a test message with the embedded model to confirm everything works.
onboarding.firstMessage.timeout: Timed out — the model may still be loading. Try again or check /embedded.
onboarding.channels.hint: Optional messaging channels: Telegram, Slack, Discord, Teams, and Matrix.
onboarding.channels.detail: Configure connectors in Settings → System → Connectors.
onboarding.profile.label: How should Akasha call you?
onboarding.ready: Setup complete. Adjust providers, channels, and memory in Settings.
research.report.print_hint: Use your browser’s Print dialog and choose “Save as PDF” (or a PDF printer).
research.report.popup_blocked: Could not open a new window — allow pop-ups for Akasha, then try again.
research.report.ready: Report ready — opened in a new window. Reopen or export it below.
research.max_rounds_help: Maximum IterResearch iterations (up to ~28 pages read per round, with Wikipedia/arXiv/Reddit/GitHub/news queries, etc.). Research stops only after at least ~18 pages across diverse domains, or when the time budget ends.
research.hero: IterResearch loop: each branch is a round; sub-branches show specialized agents (search, reader, analyst…).
research.slow_hint: Deep research may take 10–20 minutes — the star tracks rounds and sub-agents in real time.
research.background_hint: You can switch tabs — research continues in the background.
research.search_degraded: Web search is disabled — running in degraded mode (LLM knowledge only). Set web_search_enabled: true in tools_policy.yaml (SearXNG/DuckDuckGo work without API keys).
